question: A box contains 6 red balls and 4 blue balls. Three balls are drawn at random without replacement. Find the probability that at least one is blue.
explanation:
Total balls = 10

Probability at least one blue $=1-$probability all red

Number of ways all red: $\binom{6}{3}=20$

Total ways: $\binom{10}{3}=120$

So, $P(\text{all red})=\frac{20}{120}=\frac{1}{6}$

Thus, $P(\text{at least one blue})=1-\frac{1}{6}=\frac{5}{6}$
